goal: Persist compatible AuxEconomyShadow parity telemetry across /reload so repeated loop scans accumulate evidence instead of being overwritten by a fresh runtime summary, while keeping cutover arming and candidate approvals current-generation only.
notes: AH-DUMP #321 and #323 on parallel a79572f5 remained at scans=1/pages=17/decisionCompared=17 after roughly ten loop scans followed by /reload. AuxFastBridge loop reaches AVM_AuxArbScanDone normally; root cause is ParityExport.install()/publish() overwriting SavedVariables marketMeta.shadowParity with fresh runtime counters after Lua reset. This feature adds revision-compatible cumulative SavedVariables evidence with delta accounting and exposes current-generation counters separately. It does not modify AuxVmangos, PlaceAuctionBid, TransactionGuard or cutover arming; generationArmed and exact candidate matches remain current-generation only.
